flow.interpolation: original tetrahedral P1; float64 membership/values; padded float32 BVH
flow.gradient: piecewise-constant exact derivative of nodal P1 velocity; discontinuous at cell faces
flow.outside: explicit error bit 16384; no nearest-neighbour or zero-velocity continuation

simulations.VRAM_scope: whole-device sampled peak, includes other processes; not a guaranteed allocation upper bound
simulations.source_adapter: kWaveArray disc BLI weights; explicit C-order mask rows
simulations.harmonic_convention: Re[P exp(+i omega t)]; source cos(omega t + phase)

topology.scope: Discrete accepted-step graph changes; persistence never replaces raw events; not physical bubble breakup/fusion

source_identity.force_timestamp: At saved t>0, force/pressure/free velocity refer to the last physical substep input at t-dt; positions are accepted t. Initial force fields are uncomputed zeros.
source_identity.wall_gap_scope: Conservative Lipschitz lower bound from unchanged per-step final_geometry_check, not a new exact wall query.

initial_state_sources.method: If fewer than four independent archived mature families, hard-sphere random sequential placement in a radius12um ball centered on the actual F10A interior cloud; min center distance2.05R. No retries chosen by scientific success.
